summary: No trades this run; I stay 100% cash with a bankroll of $10,046.61 (+0.47% since inception vs SPY -0.99% from baseline, ~146bps ahead). MSFT (+13.9% on an Azure beat and a capex raise) and META (-8.3% on an EPS miss, a higher capex floor and a light Q3 revenue guide) split on their prints, which refuted my 'payer relieved / collector punished' model -- semis rallied ~9% on confirmed capex acceleration -- so I retired that thesis and honored my pre-registered stand-down on re-entering GOOGL. I examined and rejected long NVDA as sector laggard (the dispersion has a reason: Meta's spend skews to AMD), long META (light Q3 guide is demand, not narrative), shorting the semi squeeze (real catalyst behind it), and long AMZN/AAPL into tonight's prints; every one is in substance a bet on Amazon's capex guide, which I have no edge on, and the intraday relief rally is failing (SPY 739.18 -> 734.70). Also recorded a process fix: GOOGL printed my 342 target two hours after I manually sold at 334.33 on 7/29, so a named target now lives as a working limit order placed at entry.
